question: Can the cloud reclaim trade relative strength between ETH and BTC rather than a broad USD-direction move?
signal: Use a fixed ETH/BTC relative chart constructed only from synchronous native hourly closes. Its previous completed NY Monday's 24 hourly close ratios define the high and low. Apply the original 1.618 extension. One confirmed subsequent 12H bar has at least one hourly ratio close outside the touched extension and ends strictly between the two extensions, with matching 12H ratio EMA20/50 trend, 50 complete bars of warmup. Both contract prices must be observed. This is a separate relative-price interpretation of V1.7 with no synthetic intrahour ratio highs/lows.
account: Enter ETH in the reclaim direction and BTC in the opposite direction at the first native opens after the same 12H close. One pair at a time, equal opening USDT per leg with total notional 1x wallet. Compare ETH-only with other half held as cash, on the identical clocks. Exit once a later H1 ratio close breaks the confirming 12H key's actual hourly close extreme or the ratio EMA spread flips on a later 12H close. Use next paired native open. Charge taker 5bp per fill and additional 5bp market stress. Check every raw 1x short path against 10% maintenance plus a reserve. Hourly marked drawdown, no funding or depth. Terminal flatten at final available close and report any missing H1.
source: Only native BTC and ETH from the existing OKX archive through 2026-11-08 12UTC. Earlier pair-momentum experiment selected two different altcoins based on their independent USD charts. This experiment uses one ratio fixed beforehand, independent of the returns.
